alter-column: Dropping NOT NULL on turn_id changes only the catalog and scans no row, under 1s lock_timeout and 10s statement_timeout.
add-column: One nullable uuid column without a default on the step content table: a catalog-only change that rewrites no rows, under 1s lock_timeout and 10s statement_timeout.
add-foreign-key: The message reference is added NOT VALID, so no existing row is checked; lock acquisition on chat_messages is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and the statement by 10s statement_timeout.
add-constraint: The owner check is added NOT VALID, so no existing row is scanned; every existing row has a turn and no message, so it holds for all of them.
create-index: A partial index over message_id on the step content table, which no computer writes to before the release that follows this migration, so the build reads an empty or near-empty table; bounded by 10s statement_timeout.
